provenance: PaySim SIMULATOR output — synthetic transactions from aggregated real mobile-money logs (Kaggle ealaxi/paysim1, CC-BY-SA-4.0). ShareAlike applies to these bundled rows.
real_model: XGBoost (n_estimators=80, depth=4) distilled to a CKKS-linear logistic surrogate, fitted on the standardised features shipped here
scaling: StandardScaler fitted on the first 70% of these rows and applied to all of them, so the constants were not computed from every row. The browser reshuffles with its own run seed, so this is not - and cannot be - aligned with any particular train/test split it makes.

eda.note: Per-column statistics of the rows shipped in this file. `degenerate` names columns that carry effectively no signal and `duplicates` names pairs that are the same column twice; both are kept rather than removed so the feature order stays the one the backend, the registry and the published weights all use.
